statement: The Switch Joy-Con family shares 0x02 device information, 0x03 report mode, 0x10 SPI reads, 0x30 player lights, 0x40 IMU enable and 0x48 vibration enable with the Nintendo protocol family. The common command list includes Joy-Con-relevant pairing and MCU commands, but exact responses to unused commands are not established.
